name: Azure Bee
desc: A calm bee infused with cool energy, boosting blue pollen collection and refreshing nearby flowers. Its soothing aura increases efficiency and supports allies, making it essential for steady resource gathering and growth.

tokens.desc: Grants Blue Pollen Boost that gives +15% Blue Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Explodes 21 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 4 Pollen , Doubles Blue Pollen.

name: Basic Bee
desc: A simple and reliable bee with balanced abilities. It gathers pollen steadily, converts resources efficiently, and supports your hive with consistent performance. Perfect for beginners building a strong and dependable foundation.

name: Bomber Bee
desc: A destructive bee that drops explosive bombs, instantly collecting pollen from surrounding flowers. Its powerful blasts clear large areas quickly, making it perfect for fast farming and overwhelming field coverage.

tokens.desc: Explodes 21 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 6 Pollen , Also grants Bomb Combo Boost.
Explodes 37 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 6 Pollen , Also grants Bomb Combo Boost.

name: Cloud Bee
desc: A celestial bee adrift in an endless sky, its body woven from billowing cumulus clouds. It summons gusts of swirling wind to scatter pollen far across the field, enveloping nearby flowers in a soft, misty vapor that suspends decay and magnifies pollen yield while its airy aura drifts through the area in a sweeping, ever-shifting current of boundless atmospheric energy.

tokens.desc: Create 2 + (1 Per 5 Levels) Clouds (Lasts for 10s + 1 Per Level) that Regenerates Flowers For 30s and collect some flowers on the field (doubles white pollen).
Grants Cloud Boost that gives +4% Cloud Pollen , +2% White Pollen and 2% Capacity Bonus for 60s , stacks upto 50x.

name: Coal Bee
desc: A smoldering bee forged from deep earth pressure. It scorches nearby flowers, hardening their cores and boosting red pollen collection while radiating raw heat that fuels efficiency and ensures relentless, unyielding resource extraction.

tokens.desc: Grants Red Pollen Boost that gives +15% Red Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Grants Coal Boost that gives +2% Fire Pollen for 90 Seconds and Stacks up to 100.

name: Cold Bee
desc: A chilling bee infused with icy power. It freezes nearby flowers, slowing decay and boosting blue pollen collection while providing cooling effects that improve efficiency and help maintain stable resource gathering performance.

tokens.desc: Grants Blue Pollen Boost that gives +15% Blue Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Explodes 9 Tile with a power of 3 and gathers 8 Pollen , Doubles Blue Pollen and Creates Ice Tiles Arround that lasts for 12 seconds.

name: Crimson Bee
desc: A fierce bee filled with blazing power, specializing in red pollen collection and aggressive boosts. It enhances attack strength and burns through fields quickly, helping your hive dominate and collect resources faster.

tokens.desc: Grants Red Pollen Boost that gives +15% Red Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Explodes 21 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 4 Pollen , Doubles Red Pollen.

name: Exp Bee
desc: A luminous bee glowing with concentrated knowledge and energy. It flits purposefully through the field, leaving trails of sparkling wisdom and radiant experience orbs in its wake while its brilliant aura resonates with an empowering frequency that accelerates growth and amplifies the learning gained from every blossom it touches.

tokens.desc: Explodes 21 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 4 + (3 Per Bee's Level) Pollen.
Grants 1 + (1 Per 3 Levels) Exp Orbs that gives 100xp when used.
Grants Exp Boost that gives x1.15 Capacity Bonus & x1.05 Obsidian Pollen for 90 Seconds and Stacks up to 5.

name: Fire Bee
desc: A fiery bee radiating intense heat and energy. It scorches flowers to boost red pollen collection, increases attack power, and spreads burning effects that rapidly enhance harvesting speed and field productivity.

tokens.desc: Grants Red Pollen Boost that gives +15% Red Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Explodes 9 Tile with a power of 3 and gathers 8 Pollen , Doubles Red Pollen and Creates Fire Tiles Arround that lasts for 6 seconds.

name: Firework Bee
desc: A radiant bee crackling with festive power. It detonates cascading bursts across the field, showering flowers in luminous sparks and amplifying pollen yield while its brilliant explosions ripple outward, fueling a dazzling and relentless surge of collection.

tokens.desc: Creates 2 + (1 Per 5 Levels) Fireworks , which collect 5 patches of flowers + creates fire that lasts for 6 seconds.
Explodes 9 Tile with a power of 3 and gathers 8 Pollen , Doubles Red Pollen and Creates Fire Tiles Arround that lasts for 6 seconds.

name: Flower Bee
desc: A gentle bee devoted to nurturing flowers. It enhances bloom speed, increases pollen yield from blossoms, and spreads growth energy across fields, making nearby plants more rewarding and efficient to harvest.

tokens.desc: Grants White Pollen Boost that gives +15% White Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.

name: Hasty Bee
desc: An energetic bee that increases movement speed and attack rate for the hive. Its rapid actions help collect pollen faster, dodge threats, and improve overall efficiency during intense gathering sessions.

tokens.desc: Grants Haste Boost that gives +5% Movespeed for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.

name: Honey Bee
desc: A pure bee dedicated to the sweet essence of honey production, converting pollen with unmatched efficiency and quality. Its natural affinity for nectar creates premium honey reserves, serving as the foundation for any successful hive.

tokens.desc: Converts 100 * (Total Conversion) * (Bee's Level) Pollen Into 5 Honey Tokens Arround You.

name: Ice Bee
desc: A crystalline architect carved from eternal permafrost, shimmering with a frigid, silent grace. It glides through the air on wings of sheer frost, trailing a mist of absolute zero and delicate snowflakes that freeze moments of insight into permanent memory; its chilling aura stills the chaos of the mind, allowing for a focused, rhythmic harvest of clarity from the petals of the frozen field.

tokens.desc: Grants Blue Pollen Boost that gives +15% Blue Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Creates crystal which lasts for 8s + (1s per 3 levels) which randomly collects blue tokens and spawns ice for every blue token.

name: Icicle Bee
desc: A frigid bee encased in piercing ice. It launches razor-sharp icicles across the field, freezing nearby flowers in a crystalline frost that slows decay and amplifies pollen yield while its glacial aura blankets the area in a relentless, bone-chilling surge of frozen energy.

tokens.desc: Creates 2 + (1 Per 5 Levels) Icicles , which collect 5 patches of flowers + creates Ice that lasts for 15 seconds.
Explodes 9 Tile with a power of 3 and gathers 8 Pollen , Doubles Blue Pollen and Creates Ice Tiles Arround that lasts for 12 seconds.

name: Kitsune Bee
desc: A mythical bee infused with the cunning spirit of the kitsune. It weaves through flowers with uncanny agility, tricking pollen into yielding more than it should, and rewards sharp, strategic hive management.

tokens.desc: Grants Blossom Boost that gives x1.03 Capacity Bonus , x1.03 Blossom Pollen , x1.03 Blossom Time for 45s. and stacks upto x25.
Triggers all bombs on field and get boosted by Blossom Pollen & Upgrades flowers in their radius for 15s * Blossom Time
Creates Rain of 8 + (1 Per 3 Levels) Blossom Leafs that upgrade flowers for 12s * Blossom Time and collects 25 * Blossom Pollen - Pollen.

name: Lion Bee
desc: A majestic bee that rules the field with commanding presence, its mighty roar boosting all nearby bees' abilities. Its proud strength and territorial dominance ensure superior pollen collection while protecting its kingdom from threats.

tokens.desc: Grants Lion Aura Boost that gives +25% Attack Bonus for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 4.
Attacks all mobs on field by 5 * (Bee's Level).

name: Lucky Bee
desc: A shimmering bee radiating with golden fortune. It dances unpredictably across the field, scattering bursts of lucky clover and glittering tokens wherever it roams while its warm, glowing aura pulses with a magnetic charm that draws in rare treasures and multiplies the rewards of every flower it graces.

tokens.desc: Grants 3 Leaf Clover Boost that gives +25% Pollen & +25% Loot Luck for 30 Seconds and Stacks up to 2.
Grants 4 Leaf Clover Boost that gives +100% Pollen & +100% Loot Luck & +100% Capacity Bonus for 30 Seconds (Spawns Insane Rare).
Summons a Pot O' Gold that fills with pollen over 14 + (1s per 5 lvls) seconds. Once the time is up, everything collected inside is instantly converted into x2 honey tokens!

name: Magma Bee
desc: A core-heated sentinel forged from molten stone and pulsing obsidian. As it drones through the hive, it leaves a scorching trail of liquid fire and crystalline embers; its very presence radiates an intense, transformative heat that tempers raw potential into hardened skill, refining the essence of every flower it visits into a potent, concentrated nectar of power.

tokens.desc: Grants Red Pollen Boost that gives +15% Red Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Creates crystal which lasts for 8s + (1s per 3 levels) which randomly collects red tokens and spawns powerful fire for every red token.

name: Magnet Bee
desc: A magnetic bee that attracts nearby tokens and resources directly to the magnet. Its powerful pull draws in collectibles from a wide radius, reducing travel time and maximizing haul efficiency during every gathering run.

tokens.desc: Creates magnet that fly up and suck tokens on radius 20x20 that lasts for 9s.

name: Null Bee
desc: A mysterious bee that exists in a void state, erasing flower cooldowns and resetting pollen timers instantly. Its reality-warping emptiness creates opportunities from nothing, making it invaluable for exploiting field mechanics.

tokens.desc: Explodes 37 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 6 Pollen , Also grants Bomb Combo Boost.
Creates 3 + (1 Per 3 Levels) Prism Beans that Collect 500 Pollen.

name: Oil Bee
desc: A viscous bee gleaming with dark iridescence, its form composed of flowing obsidian streams that ripple with rainbow sheens. It releases thick, amber droplets that coat the field in protective resin, encasing nearby flowers in a preserving glaze that extends their lifespan and intensifies their essence while its slick aura spreads through the area in slow, deliberate waves of liquid preservation and ancient, earthbound energy.

tokens.desc: Grants Oil Boost that gives +0.1% Fire Pollen Forever and Stacks up to 5000.
Explodes 9 Tile with a power of 3 and gathers 8 Pollen , Doubles Red Pollen and Creates Fire Tiles Arround that lasts for 6 seconds.

name: Oni Bee
desc: A fearsome bee possessed by an oni's restless spirit. It tears through fields with relentless aggression, smashing through pollen caps that would slow ordinary bees, built for players who want raw, unforgiving power.

tokens.desc: Grants Soul Fire Boost that gives 10% Critical Power, 1% Critical Chance and x1.03 Fire Pollen for 45s. stacks upto x25.
Cover 9 Patches into Soul Fire that lasts 12s + (1 Per Bee's Level) and collects x6 more than normal fire and grants Soul Fire Combo.
Instantly make fire & soul fire convert pollen into honey ( 500 * Total Conversion * Fire Pollen) for 7s every 1s.

name: Pixel Bee
desc: A retro-inspired bee built from blocks of pure nostalgia. Its pixelated form may look simple, but don't be fooled — beneath those sharp edges lies a surprisingly capable worker. A charming collectible for those who appreciate the classics.

tokens.desc: Grants Pixel Boost that gives x1.2 Pollen and x1.2 Capacity Bonus for 60 Seconds.

name: Rage Bee
desc: An furious bee consumed by uncontrollable anger, attacking flowers with violent intensity to extract maximum pollen. Its explosive temper multiplies collection power but burns through stamina, perfect for short bursts of overwhelming production.

tokens.desc: Grants Rage Boost that gives +1 Bee Attack for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 3.
Explodes 21 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 6 Pollen , Also grants Bomb Combo Boost.

name: Ryujin Bee
desc: A legendary bee channeling the might of the ryujin. It commands the hive with draconic authority, surging pollen production in powerful bursts and overwhelming rivals with sheer dominance.

tokens.desc: Creates Bubble that have ( (1/10 of player's capacity * (1 + Bee's Level / 10) ) * Bubble Capacity) and lasts for 60s * Bubble Time. When time expires bubble pops giving player Bubble Combo and honey.
Grants Bubble Boost that gives x1.05 Blue Pollen , x1.03 Bubble Capacity , x1.03 Bubble Time for 45s. and stacks upto x25.
Increase all active bubbles' capacity by 10% and pollen by 10%.

name: Science Bee
desc: An analytical bee equipped with experimental apparatus that converts collected resources into research data. Its methodical approach increases token quality through systematic observation, occasionally discovering rare specimens and bonus materials that other bees would overlook during standard gathering operations.

tokens.desc: Grants Science Boost that gives 10% Energy Bonus for 60s. Stacks upto 10x.

name: Shark Bee
desc: A ferocious bee that hunts through fields with predatory precision, aggressively collecting pollen in devastating sweeps. Its razor-sharp instincts and relentless speed tear through flowers, dominating any territory it claims.

tokens.desc: Attacks all mobs on field by 25 * (Bee's Level).
Creates 2 + (1 Per 5 Levels) Waves Arround Token That Collects 21 Flower Patches and collect 12 Pollen every 0.3s for 5s and Collect All Tokens on its way.

name: Sound Bee
desc: A resonant bee vibrating with sonic frequency. It reverberates through nearby flowers, amplifying their bloom and boosting echo pollen collection while emitting harmonic waves that sharpen efficiency and sustain a rhythmic, uninterrupted resource flow.

tokens.desc: Grants Sound Boost that gives +5% Capacity for 30 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Explodes 37 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 6 Pollen , Also grants Bomb Combo Boost.
Grants Music Boost that gives +2% Critical Chance & 10% Critical Power for 45 Seconds and Stacks up to 5..

name: Sunny Bee
desc: A radiant bee that radiates intense sunlight, warming flowers to boost pollen production. Its brilliant golden glow energizes nearby bees and accelerates honey conversion, making it essential for maximizing field efficiency.

tokens.desc: For 5s + (1 per Level) 1 token [Solar Boost] spawns in field every 1s. That grants +10% Solar Pollen and stacks upto 100.
Creates 2 + (1 Per 3 Levels) Sun Beams that Collects 30 Pollen from 21 Tiles and multiples by Solar Pollen.

name: Thunder Bee
desc: A tempestuous bee crackling with electric fury, its form wreathed in storm clouds that pulse with veins of lightning. It calls forth thunderous roars that shake the earth and ignite the air with cascading bolts, charging nearby flowers with raw electrical energy that accelerates their growth while its crackling aura surges through the area in violent, electrifying waves of pure storm-born power.

tokens.desc: Grants Thunder Boost that gives +0.1% Cloud Pollen Forever and Stacks up to 5000.
Explodes 37 Tile with a power of 7 and gathers 6 Pollen , Also grants Bomb Combo Boost.

name: Water Bee
desc: A fluid bee coursing with tidal energy. It hydrates nearby flowers, accelerating growth and boosting aqua pollen collection while generating gentle currents that enhance efficiency and help sustain a steady, flowing resource output.

tokens.desc: Grants Blue Pollen Boost that gives +15% Blue Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Grants Water Boost that gives +2% Ice Pollen for 90 Seconds and Stacks up to 100.

name: Wave Bee
desc: An oceanic bee flowing like liquid starlight, its body formed from cascading tidal currents that shimmer with deep blue luminescence. It conjures rhythmic pulses of crystalline water that wash over the field in gentle, nourishing waves, bathing nearby flowers in healing moisture that enhances their vitality while its fluid aura ebbs and flows through the area in endless, hypnotic cycles of aquatic serenity.

tokens.desc: Grants Wave Boost that gives +0.1% Ice Pollen Forever and Stacks up to 5000.
Explodes 9 Tile with a power of 3 and gathers 8 Pollen , Doubles Blue Pollen and Creates Ice Tiles Arround that lasts for 12 seconds.

name: Windy Bee
desc: A translucent spirit of the atmosphere, composed of swirling zephyrs and captured starlight. It moves with a restless, unpredictable elegance, leaving behind spiraling slipstreams of inspiration and echoing whispers of ancient secrets; its breezy resonance lifts the spirit, accelerating the pace of discovery and carrying the pollen of innovation across vast distances with a single, effortless gust.

tokens.desc: Grants White Pollen Boost that gives +15% White Pollen for 60 Seconds and Stacks up to 10.
Creates crystal which lasts for 8s + (1s per 3 levels) which randomly collects white tokens and spawns 2 clouds for every white token.
